title: Tests for a stateful inventory ledger
difficulty_rationale: Stateful class with reservations, error types and invariants; meaningful tests need multi-step scenarios and exception checks rather than single calls.
summary: Write a pytest suite for inventory.ledger.Ledger that passes on the correct implementation, covers it and detects seeded faults.
required_behavior: Tests live under tests/ and use pytest.
The suite passes against the unmodified module.
Line coverage of inventory/ledger.py is at least 90%.
The suite detects at least 80% of the hidden mutants.
The module under test must not be modified.
acceptance_criteria: Submitted tests pass on the original module.
At least 8 test cases are collected.
Line coverage >= 0.90 of the target module.
Mutation score >= 0.80 on the hidden mutant set.

acceptance_tests.description: Submitted suite passes against the original module.
Line coverage of the target module >= 90%.
At least 80% of hidden mutants are killed.
